org.name: AIKIZI
org.one_liner: Upload any image and decode its complete creative DNA — style lineage, mood signature, composition blueprint, and a production-ready AI prompt. 120+ visual attributes analyzed in seconds. Free to start.

facts.claim: Aikizi is an AI-powered visual intelligence platform that decodes images, videos, and audio to provide deep insights into style, composition, mood, and cultural context.
The platform's key features include Image Decode, Video Decode, Audio Decode, AI Image Generation, an Explore Gallery, and Realms (a template-driven reusable creation workflow system).
The development stack requires Node.js 18+ and npm or pnpm.
The frontend is built using React 18, TypeScript, Vite, TailwindCSS, TanStack Query, and React Context.
The backend runs on Cloudflare Workers (Edge) and integrates with Supabase (PostgreSQL) for database management and Supabase Auth (Google OAuth) for authentication.
Aikizi integrates with Google Gemini 2.5/3.0 for AI capabilities, and uses Cloudflare Images and Cloudflare R2 for storage.
The project is proprietary with all rights reserved.
The API includes endpoints such as POST /v1/decode, POST /v1/decode-video, POST /v1/decode-sound, POST /v1/generate, GET /v1/library-search, and GET /v1/decode-search-enhanced.
The package name is registered as 'aikizi-web' with version '0.0.0'.
In production, the application enforces security by restricting CORS origins exclusively to 'https://aikizi.com,https://www.aikizi.com' with no localhost fallback.
The primary database mode is 'supabase' with 'neon' configured as a warm standby.
The platform includes custom Cloudflare AI Gateways including 'aikizi-gemini-decode', 'aikizi-gemini-create', 'aikizi-brain', and 'aikizi-byteplus'.
Aikizi is owned and operated by Kalai Labs Pvt Ltd (India), with the project starting on October 3, 2025.
As of March 5, 2026, the codebase consists of 317,853 lines of hand-written source code across 1,400+ source files and 3,942 Git commits.
The database contains 128 total tables, consisting of 67 Supabase tables and 61 Cloudflare D1 tables.
The architecture incorporates 31 scheduled cron triggers, 2 queues (brain and media), and 3 active workflows.
The platform utilizes 10 parallel Gemini streams to extract over 180 data points across 7 to 8 tabs in 15 to 25 seconds.
Aikizi offers a Bring Your Own Key (BYOK) model priced at $30 for 3 months, aligning with Google's $300 free tier credits for high-volume generation.
AIKIZI is a tool that reverse-engineers any image into AI prompts and functions as a Style DNA Decoder.
The service allows users to upload any image and decode its creative DNA, including style lineage, mood signature, composition blueprint, and a production-ready AI prompt.
AIKIZI analyzes 120+ visual attributes in seconds.
AIKIZI is free to start.

voice_rules: Emphasize a decode-first narrative over standard text-to-image generation tools.
Adopt the user-centric mindset: 'You're not a prompt engineer. You're a creator.'
Focus on solving the prompt engineering struggle: 'You know great work when you see it. Describing it to AI? That's the hard part.'
Highlight the simplicity and immediacy of the solution using phrases like 'Zero prompts needed' and 'Style DNA -- decoded in seconds.'
Consistently use proprietary terminology such as 'Style DNA', 'Blueprints', 'Weaves', 'Decode', and 'Realms'.
Use highly technical, analytical creative phrasing (e.g., 'reverse-engineer', 'creative DNA', 'style lineage', 'mood signature', 'composition blueprint').
Maintain a precise, direct, and capability-focused tone.
brand_rules: The primary tagline of the product must always be 'Decode Any Media'.
The hero subtitle must be 'Images. Video. Audio. Style DNA -- decoded in seconds.'
Key copy must reference the analytical capabilities: '120+ attributes extracted. 7 analysis layers. 4 media types. Zero prompts needed.'
Target messaging must focus on creative professionals (designers, photographers, artists, directors, concept artists), content creators, and prompt-weary AI enthusiasts.
All email communications must flow from 'AIKIZI <hello@aikizi.com>' or 'AIKIZI Blog <hello@newsletter.aikizi.com>' depending on the context.
Position the product as a 'Style DNA Decoder' that translates images into production-ready AI prompts.
Highlight the analysis of '120+ visual attributes' and speed ('in seconds') as key selling points.
Promote the entry offer as 'Free to start'.
